title: split lint config into workspace-aware adapter and fastpath lanes
author: Aisha Rahman
description: Motivation: presubmit latency and noisy lint runs were slowing local dev and CI; current monolithic lint pipeline runs many rules for small changes and rebuilds whole config on workspace splits. This PR breaks the lint configuration into a lightweight workspace-aware adapter and an opt-in fastpath lane for churn-heavy directories. Goals: 1) reduce presubmit latency for busy workspaces (sdk, examples) 2) keep full lint coverage gated on staged lanes 3) enable incremental lint caching and simpler rule scoping. What I changed: introduced a new `lint-adapter` manifest that composes per-workspace config, added `fastpath` labels and routing in presubmit-orchestrator, moved shared eslint/ruff config into `ci/lint/shared/` and added a small shim that loads only relevant plugins based on changed files, added a small Go helper to compute workspace scopes in CI, and bumped a handful of lint-related devdeps (eslint -> 8.48.0, ruff -> 0.12.0). Rollout plan: deploy adapter to presubmit staging, enable fastpath for `redwood-sdk-python` and `redwood-examples` for 48h, monitor presubmit latency and lint failure rate, then flip for other repos. Rollback: revert head branch or disable fastpath label mapping in presubmit orchestrator. Performance: on a synthetic workload of 150 small PRs the average presubmit lint runtime dropped from 2m14s to 32s on the fastpath lane (60% less overall CI time observed across sample). Testing: unit tests for adapter loader, integration smoke for presubmit routing, e2e on a snapshot of sdk and examples. Notes: kept full lint runner unchanged; this is an additive refactor with opt-in fastpath; consumers needing stricter rules will continue to go through the full lane. Related: ENG-1742 (presubmit latency), ENG-1815 (lint infra hygiene).

Aisha Rahman (author reply): Added a 30s debounce in presubmit-orchestrator and added an explicit opt-out annotation for repos that want full-lint always. See ci/presubmit/orchestrator/main.go diff.
Lena Fischer (approved): Verified presubmit staging runs and observed stable fallbacks. Small request: include a note in the release docs about how to opt into fastpath.

merge_result: squash and merge by Lena Fischer; merge commit message: 'split(lint): workspace-aware adapter + fastpath lanes — reduce presubmit latency and enable workspace scoping'
release_notes: Add workspace-aware lint adapter and opt-in fastpath presubmit lanes to reduce presubmit latency for large repos. Includes devdep bumps for eslint and ruff and a new workspace scope helper. Fastpath is opt-in and can be rolled back by disabling label mapping in the presubmit orchestrator.
